home.title: Photo and Signature Resize for Exam Forms | SahiSize
home.description: Photo and signature resize online for exam forms: exact pixels and KB for IBPS, SBI, SSC, RRB, NEET, UPSC and more. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
home.hero: Exam photo & signature resize — right size, first time.
home.heroTagline: Exam form ke photo, signature, sab — sahi size mein.
home.heroSub: Pick your exam. We fit every document to the official pixel size and KB range, right on your phone.
home.heroArtAlt: A 4.2 MB phone photo (3024×4032) turned into an 18.8 KB passport-size photo, 200×230 px, stamped PASS.
home.how1Text: Search for it. We load the official sizes from the notification.
home.how2Text: Take a photo or choose from gallery. Crop it inside the guide.
home.how3Text: Auto-fit hits the exact pixels and KB. Every rule shows a tick before you download.
home.faq1a: Yes. Every tool and exam kit is free. There is no login and no pop-up ads.
home.faq2a: No. Everything runs inside your browser on your own phone or computer. Your files are never sent to any server. After the first visit the site even works offline.
home.faq3q: Where do the sizes come from?
home.faq3a: From the exam's official notification wherever we could verify it. Sizes we could only find in secondary sources are clearly labelled “Unverified”. Every exam page links its source and shows the date we last checked it.
home.faq4a: It is the file size the form accepts. The file must be bigger than 20 KB and smaller than 50 KB. Auto-fit aims just under the top of the range, with a safety margin, so the file passes whether a portal counts 1 KB as 1000 or 1024 bytes.
home.faq5q: The portal still rejected my file. What now?
home.faq5a: Tell us on the report page with the exact error message. We re-check the notice and fix the size quickly.
home.faqArtAlt: Upload size check: an 86 KB photo is rejected because the limit is 20–50 KB. Fitted to 23 KB, the same photo passes.
